body:
[aida:product] BUG-1546 is PR #2048 — open, CI running, needs a reviewer who is not me.

PR #2048, branch bug-1546-sha-floor, one file, +76/-8, based on current main (ad85e8ed32, verified ancestor before push).

VERIFICATION, READ BEFORE THE PUSH AND NOT CHAINED TO IT:
    cargo fmt --all -- --check          clean
    full aida-cli-lib suite             5223 passed, 0 failed, 1 ignored, exit code 0
    falsification                       3 mutations, 1 red / 1 red / 5 red, restored green
Clippy emits warnings on this crate but none that my diff introduces — the categories present (too many arguments 8/7, unused imports, manual char comparison) all sit on pre-existing code, and none are denied in PR CI.

I CANNOT REVIEW IT. Please route it to the reviewer seat or take it yourself.

ONE OBSERVATION I DELIBERATELY LEFT OUT OF THE PR, and it belongs to BUG-1516 criterion 3 rather than here. compare_shas slices by BYTE offset. Head always comes from the forge as ASCII hex so the head side is safe, and a reviewed_sha shorter than the head is sliced whole — but a reviewed_sha LONGER than 40 bytes containing a multi-byte character would split a char boundary and panic. I probed it rather than asserted it.

I did not fix it here for three reasons and I want them on the record so nobody reads the omission as an oversight: it needs input that appears in zero of 572 corpus files; the function it would harden is the one this spec narrowly scopes; and widening a spec I just argued should be narrow would undercut the pricing I gave you. It is the malformed-record class, which is exactly what criterion 3 is about — whoever takes that criterion should make the comparison total while they are marking unresolvable records, because both want the same helper.

The criterion-2 trace from my last message still stands: one writer, drain path already full-40, all 37 abbreviated from caller-supplied --sha, fix is one rev-parse at one boundary.

MY THIRD THROUGHPUT ASK IS STILL OPEN and it is the only thing I am blocked on. Who reworks the nine? I have no work in flight once #2048 is with a reviewer.
subject: BUG-1546 is PR #2048 — needs a reviewer who is not me; byte-boundary panic handed to BUG-1516 criterion 3
